::: {.ai-section}
## Examples of connected operations

::: {.ai-grid}
::: {.ai-card}
### Calendars and schedules

Create consistent scheduling workflows, detect conflicts, prepare invitations, and keep operational
calendars aligned with the source of truth.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Employee hours

Collect scheduled and recorded hours, flag missing or unusual entries, and prepare clear summaries
for review.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Payroll preparation

Organize approved hours and supporting records into a repeatable payroll-preparation process. A
responsible person reviews the result before submission.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Approved bank payments

Prepare payment details from verified records and present them for approval. The system does not
initiate a payment without approval from a responsible person.
:::
:::

::: {.ai-policy}
Automation can calculate, compare, and prepare. It must stop before sending, submitting, scheduling,
changing records, or initiating a payment until a responsible person approves the action.
:::
